checker.closure_scope: Transitive import-time repository closure; deferred function/native CAD imports are explicitly outside this source-controls scope

workflow.only_added_step:
- name: Exact protected repository import closure and real absent-module controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p hw/soc/out/cdr-v59-loaded-controls
          PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 scripts/check_cdr_v59_loaded_imports.py | tee hw/soc/out/cdr-v59-loaded-controls/imports.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import json
          r=json.load(open('hw/soc/out/cdr-v59-loaded-controls/imports.json'))
          assert r['status']=='PASS_CURRENT_V59_LOADED_IMPORT_CLOSURE_AND_ACTUAL_ABSENCE_CONTROLS_NOT_NATIVE'
          assert len(r['positives'])==4 and len(r['rejected'])==9
          assert r['closure']['installed_allowlist']=={} and r['source_controls_only']
          assert not r['preparation_executed'] and not r['simulation_executed'] and not r['prior_archive_downloaded']
          PY
